lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [breathless, dramatic] What if Roblox... shut down... FOREVER?
lines.text: What if Roblox... shut down... FOREVER?

lines.speaker: LAG
lines.raw: [slow, deep, glitchy] One... min... min... minute... left.
lines.text: One... min... min... minute... left.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.raw: [panicking] Juno! There's no respawn in real life! I checked!
lines.text: Juno! There's no respawn in real life! I checked!

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.raw: [shouting] Hold on to your helmets!
lines.text: Hold on to your helmets!

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [determined, shouting] Pip! Press the button!
lines.text: Pip! Press the button!

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.raw: [cheerful, tiny] Ding!
lines.text: Ding!

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [calm, to camera] Okay. You're probably wondering how a girl in a hard hat ended up running from a giant lag monster.
lines.text: Okay. You're probably wondering how a girl in a hard hat ended up running from a giant lag monster.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [storyteller] Let's go back twenty-four hours.
lines.text: Let's go back twenty-four hours.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [cheerful] Hi! I'm Juno. I'm eleven. And I'm a builder.
lines.text: Hi! I'm Juno. I'm eleven. And I'm a builder.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [proud] That's why I wear the hard hat. [pause] Builders wear hard hats. [pause] Also, I fall off my chair a lot.
lines.text: That's why I wear the hard hat. Builders wear hard hats. Also, I fall off my chair a lot.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: Not houses. Games. For three years, I've been building my own Roblox game.
lines.text: Not houses. Games. For three years, I've been building my own Roblox game.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [proud, dreamy] It's called Bubble Island. Islands... inside bubbles. You float from one to the next. [pause] It's a masterpiece.
lines.text: It's called Bubble Island. Islands... inside bubbles. You float from one to the next. It's a masterpiece.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [deadpan] It has three visits.
lines.text: It has three visits.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: One is me. One is my cat. And one is Grandpa, by accident. He thought it was the weather app.
lines.text: One is me. One is my cat. And one is Grandpa, by accident. He thought it was the weather app.

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.raw: [confused, warm] Juno, why is tomorrow's weather... soap?
lines.text: Juno, why is tomorrow's weather... soap?

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: That's Grandpa Otto. He lives with us. He carries one hundred keys... and he won't tell anyone what they open.
lines.text: That's Grandpa Otto. He lives with us. He carries one hundred keys... and he won't tell anyone what they open.

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.raw: [mysterious, whispering] Some doors... are better left closed.
lines.text: Some doors... are better left closed.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [aside] He also uses a mop as a walking stick. Nobody knows why.
lines.text: He also uses a mop as a walking stick. Nobody knows why.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: Mom and Dad don't play. [pause] Dad says video games rot your brain.
lines.text: Mom and Dad don't play. Dad says video games rot your brain.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: And this is my best friend, Dex.
lines.text: And this is my best friend, Dex.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.raw: [cocky, fast] Twelve thousand hours. Every obby. Every boss. Every badge. I have NEVER fallen. Not once.
lines.text: Twelve thousand hours. Every obby. Every boss. Every badge. I have NEVER fallen. Not once.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [aside, deadpan] In the game. In real life... he's scared of stairs.
lines.text: In the game. In real life... he's scared of stairs.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.raw: [nervous] Stairs don't have checkpoints, Juno! If I fall, where do I spawn?!
lines.text: Stairs don't have checkpoints, Juno! If I fall, where do I spawn?!

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [deadpan] On the floor, Dex. You spawn on the floor.
lines.text: On the floor, Dex. You spawn on the floor.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: And this is my little brother, Pip. He's six. He plays exactly one game.
lines.text: And this is my little brother, Pip. He's six. He plays exactly one game.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.raw: [excited, tiny] Elevator Simulator!
lines.text: Elevator Simulator!

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.raw: [happy] Ding!
lines.text: Ding!

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: He has ridden the same elevator... forty-one thousand times. He knows every button in every elevator in the game.
lines.text: He has ridden the same elevator... forty-one thousand times. He knows every button in every elevator in the game.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.raw: [proud] Ding!
lines.text: Ding!

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [sighs] It's the only word he's said since Christmas.
lines.text: It's the only word he's said since Christmas.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [storyteller] It was a normal Tuesday. Six p.m. Peak gaming hour.
lines.text: It was a normal Tuesday. Six p.m. Peak gaming hour.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: And then... every screen in the world... showed the same message.
lines.text: And then... every screen in the world... showed the same message.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.raw: [calm, polite, robotic] Attention, players. Roblox will shut down forever... in twenty-four hours.
lines.text: Attention, players. Roblox will shut down forever... in twenty-four hours.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.raw: [cheerful] Thanks for playing! Smiley face.
lines.text: Thanks for playing! Smiley face.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.raw: [devastated, screaming] FOREVER?! Like... FOREVER forever?!
lines.text: FOREVER?! Like... FOREVER forever?!

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.raw: [sobbing] I have a nine-hundred-day login streak!
lines.text: I have a nine-hundred-day login streak!

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.raw: [small, sad] ...Even the elevator?
lines.text: ...Even the elevator?

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [nervous, whispering] It's fine. It's just a game. [pause] ...Not my fish. Please, not my fish.
lines.text: It's fine. It's just a game. ...Not my fish. Please, not my fish.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [panicked] My game isn't finished! Bubble Island has no ending! The bubbles don't even POP yet!
lines.text: My game isn't finished! Bubble Island has no ending! The bubbles don't even POP yet!

lines.speaker: ANCHOR
lines.raw: [dramatic, news] Breaking news! The world has entered... the Final Twenty-Four Hours!
lines.text: Breaking news! The world has entered... the Final Twenty-Four Hours!

lines.speaker: ANCHOR
lines.raw: Schools are closed. Parents are confused. And one kid has already fainted. [pause] Twice.
lines.text: Schools are closed. Parents are confused. And one kid has already fainted. Twice.

lines.speaker: ANCHOR
lines.raw: [dramatic] Ten thousand players are trying to beat the same obby at the same time. [pause] And a dog has learned to say "oof."
lines.text: Ten thousand players are trying to beat the same obby at the same time. And a dog has learned to say "oof."

lines.speaker: ANCHOR
lines.raw: [serious] Experts say the shutdown cannot be stopped. [pause] Experts also say they're going to go play now. Goodbye!
lines.text: Experts say the shutdown cannot be stopped. Experts also say they're going to go play now. Goodbye!

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: The countdown started. And the whole world... went a little bit crazy.
lines.text: The countdown started. And the whole world... went a little bit crazy.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: Everybody made a list. The "last day" list.
lines.text: Everybody made a list. The "last day" list.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: Kids spent the Robux they'd been saving for years.
lines.text: Kids spent the Robux they'd been saving for years.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: Every server was full. Every obby had a line. One obby had a line... for the line.
lines.text: Every server was full. Every obby had a line. One obby had a line... for the line.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: One guy finally read the Terms of Service. All of them. [pause] It took eleven hours. He said the ending was disappointing.
lines.text: One guy finally read the Terms of Service. All of them. It took eleven hours. He said the ending was disappointing.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: Even our math teacher canceled the test... so he could finish his tycoon.
lines.text: Even our math teacher canceled the test... so he could finish his tycoon.

lines.speaker: STREAMER
lines.raw: [hyped, screaming] Chat! This is the last stream EVER! I will not blink! I will not sleep! [pause] I will not... [yawns] ...okay, maybe one nap.
lines.text: Chat! This is the last stream EVER! I will not blink! I will not sleep! I will not... ...okay, maybe one nap.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [serious, emotional] Kids. Sit down. I need to tell you something.
lines.text: Kids. Sit down. I need to tell you something.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [ashamed] I'm level nine hundred... in a fishing game.
lines.text: I'm level nine hundred... in a fishing game.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [shocked] Dad! You said video games rot your brain!
lines.text: Dad! You said video games rot your brain!

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [defensive] It's not a game! It's RELAXING! [voice cracking] And tonight... I was finally going to catch the Golden Fish!
lines.text: It's not a game! It's RELAXING! And tonight... I was finally going to catch the Golden Fish!

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: Even Mom had a list.
lines.text: Even Mom had a list.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [deadpan] She said she was taking a bath. [pause] For six hours.
lines.text: She said she was taking a bath. For six hours.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.raw: [stressed] I have every badge in Roblox... except one. The secret one. The "Touch Grass" badge.
lines.text: I have every badge in Roblox... except one. The secret one. The "Touch Grass" badge.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.raw: [frustrated] Nobody knows how to get it! I searched every map! Every cave! Every... grass texture!
lines.text: Nobody knows how to get it! I searched every map! Every cave! Every... grass texture!

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.raw: [sad, tiny] Goodbye, Mister Elevator Man. You were the best elevator man.
lines.text: Goodbye, Mister Elevator Man. You were the best elevator man.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.raw: [sad, small] Ding. [pause] Ding. [pause] ...Ding.
lines.text: Ding. Ding. ...Ding.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [determined] And me? I had one thing on my list. Finish Bubble Island. Before the world forgot it ever existed.
lines.text: And me? I had one thing on my list. Finish Bubble Island. Before the world forgot it ever existed.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.raw: [confused] Juno... I just fell through the whole world.
lines.text: Juno... I just fell through the whole world.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [quickly] That's not a bug. That's... the secret underwater level.
lines.text: That's not a bug. That's... the secret underwater level.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.raw: [deadpan] There's no water. It's just grey. Forever.
lines.text: There's no water. It's just grey. Forever.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [defeated] ...It's a very secret level.
lines.text: ...It's a very secret level.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [tired] At midnight, I was almost done. Twelve islands. Three hundred bubbles. One very tired builder.
lines.text: At midnight, I was almost done. Twelve islands. Three hundred bubbles. One very tired builder.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [uneasy] Then my game started... lagging.
lines.text: Then my game started... lagging.

lines.speaker: LAG
lines.raw: [slow, deep, glitchy] Mmm... bub... bub... bubbles.
lines.text: Mmm... bub... bub... bubbles.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [startled] Who said that?!
lines.text: Who said that?!

lines.speaker: LAG
lines.raw: [slow, deep, glitchy] I... am... [long pause] ...the LAAAG.
lines.text: I... am... ...the LAAAG.

lines.speaker: LAG
lines.raw: [hungry, slow] More players... more... rushing... more... FOOD.
lines.text: More players... more... rushing... more... FOOD.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [brave, shaky] Get out of my game! This is MY game!
lines.text: Get out of my game! This is MY game!

lines.speaker: LAG
lines.raw: [slow, mocking] Your... game... has... three... visits. [pause] Nobody... will... miss... it.
lines.text: Your... game... has... three... visits. Nobody... will... miss... it.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [hurt, quiet] ...Rude.
lines.text: ...Rude.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [whispering, scared] And then my cat... lagged. In REAL LIFE.
lines.text: And then my cat... lagged. In REAL LIFE.

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.raw: [grave, quiet] So. He's back.
lines.text: So. He's back.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [shocked] Grandpa?! You KNOW about the lag monster?!
lines.text: Grandpa?! You KNOW about the lag monster?!

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.raw: [serious] Juno... for thirty years, I was the night janitor... at the Server Farm.
lines.text: Juno... for thirty years, I was the night janitor... at the Server Farm.

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.raw: [proud, mysterious] The place where all of Roblox lives.
lines.text: The place where all of Roblox lives.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [stunned] So the hundred keys...
lines.text: So the hundred keys...

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.raw: [proud] Ninety-nine of them open the Server Farm. [pause] One opens my locker. There's a sandwich in there from nineteen ninety-eight.
lines.text: Ninety-nine of them open the Server Farm. One opens my locker. There's a sandwich in there from nineteen ninety-eight.

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.raw: Back then, the Lag was tiny. I'd shoo him away with my mop. But he feeds on traffic. The more everyone rushes at once... the bigger he gets.
lines.text: Back then, the Lag was tiny. I'd shoo him away with my mop. But he feeds on traffic. The more everyone rushes at once... the bigger he gets.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [realizing] And today... the whole world is rushing at once.
lines.text: And today... the whole world is rushing at once.

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.raw: That's why they're shutting it all down. To starve him. Forever.
lines.text: That's why they're shutting it all down. To starve him. Forever.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [determined] So if we stop the Lag... Roblox doesn't have to shut down?
lines.text: So if we stop the Lag... Roblox doesn't have to shut down?

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.raw: [grinning] Get your helmet, builder.
lines.text: Get your helmet, builder.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: At six a.m., we had a van, a key... and a team.
lines.text: At six a.m., we had a van, a key... and a team.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.raw: [scared] No way. Real life has no respawn, no checkpoints, and no mini-map!
lines.text: No way. Real life has no respawn, no checkpoints, and no mini-map!

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [calm] It has snacks.
lines.text: It has snacks.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.raw: [pause] ...I'm in.
lines.text: ...I'm in.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.raw: [cheerful] Ding!
lines.text: Ding!

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [sighs] And a stowaway.
lines.text: And a stowaway.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: The closer we got to the Server Farm... the laggier the world became.
lines.text: The closer we got to the Server Farm... the laggier the world became.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.raw: [nervous, whispering] Juno. That cow is... loading.
lines.text: Juno. That cow is... loading.

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.raw: [cheerful] Don't worry! Betsy hasn't gone over forty miles an hour since nineteen ninety-eight!
lines.text: Don't worry! Betsy hasn't gone over forty miles an hour since nineteen ninety-eight!

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.raw: [deadpan] Did we just... lag backwards?
lines.text: Did we just... lag backwards?

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.raw: [robotic, glitchy] Recalculating. Recalculating. Re... re... recalculating.
lines.text: Recalculating. Recalculating. Re... re... recalculating.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [laughs] Twelve hours left. And we were going backwards.
lines.text: Twelve hours left. And we were going backwards.

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.raw: [serious] The Lag lives in the Core. The very bottom floor. Nobody's been down there in years.
lines.text: The Lag lives in the Core. The very bottom floor. Nobody's been down there in years.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: And when we get there... what's the plan?
lines.text: And when we get there... what's the plan?

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.raw: [cheerful] I was hoping you had one. You're the builder.
lines.text: I was hoping you had one. You're the builder.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [deadpan] Great. Great plan, Grandpa.
lines.text: Great. Great plan, Grandpa.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: We stopped for gas. [pause] The cashier was... buffering.
lines.text: We stopped for gas. The cashier was... buffering.

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.raw: [polite] One coffee, please.
lines.text: One coffee, please.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.raw: [whispering] Is he okay?
lines.text: Is he okay?

lines.speaker: CASHIER
lines.raw: [fast, glitchy] That'll-be-two-dollars-have-a-nice-day-have-a-nice-day-have-a-nice-day.
lines.text: That'll-be-two-dollars-have-a-nice-day-have-a-nice-day-have-a-nice-day.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.raw: [whiny, tiny] Are we there yet? [pause] Ding?
lines.text: Are we there yet? Ding?

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.raw: [chuckles, warm] Not yet, little elevator.
lines.text: Not yet, little elevator.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.raw: [quiet, surprised] Huh. The graphics out here are... actually really good.
lines.text: Huh. The graphics out here are... actually really good.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [awed] The Server Farm. Every game. Every avatar. Every obby ever made. All in one building.
lines.text: The Server Farm. Every game. Every avatar. Every obby ever made. All in one building.

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.raw: [nostalgic, warm] Thirty years... and she hasn't changed a bit.
lines.text: Thirty years... and she hasn't changed a bit.

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.raw: [offended] Expired?! I mopped these floors for thirty years!
lines.text: Expired?! I mopped these floors for thirty years!

lines.speaker: MODBOT
lines.raw: [robotic, stern] Intruders detected! Leave now, or you will be... beep beep beep beep!
lines.text: Intruders detected! Leave now, or you will be... beep beep beep beep!

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.raw: [scared] Did that robot just get chat-filtered?!
lines.text: Did that robot just get chat-filtered?!

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.raw: [fake robot voice, badly] Beep. Boop. I am... also a robot. Nothing to see here.
lines.text: Beep. Boop. I am... also a robot. Nothing to see here.

lines.speaker: MODBOT
lines.raw: [robotic, suspicious] ...Welcome, colleague.
lines.text: ...Welcome, colleague.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.raw: [whispering, amazed] That should NOT have worked.
lines.text: That should NOT have worked.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.raw: [sneezing] Ah... ah... ACHOO!
lines.text: Ah... ah... ACHOO!

lines.speaker: MODBOT
lines.raw: [robotic, alarmed] Intruders! Intruders! Beep beep beep!
lines.text: Intruders! Intruders! Beep beep beep!

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [panicked] A service elevator with four hundred buttons! Nobody knows which one—
lines.text: A service elevator with four hundred buttons! Nobody knows which one—

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.raw: [calm, expert] Basement nine. Then up two. Then hold "close door" for three seconds.
lines.text: Basement nine. Then up two. Then hold "close door" for three seconds.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.raw: [proud] Ding!
lines.text: Ding!

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [amazed] Forty-one thousand elevator rides... and they finally paid off.
lines.text: Forty-one thousand elevator rides... and they finally paid off.

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.raw: [impressed, warm] That's my grandson.
lines.text: That's my grandson.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.raw: [whispering] Ding.
lines.text: Ding.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: Floor one. The Cooling Room. Where the servers chill out.
lines.text: Floor one. The Cooling Room. Where the servers chill out.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.raw: [screaming] No respawn! No respawn! NO RESPAWN!
lines.text: No respawn! No respawn! NO RESPAWN!

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.raw: [cheerful] Thirty years of mopping, kid! Bend your knees!
lines.text: Thirty years of mopping, kid! Bend your knees!

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.raw: [giggling] Ding!
lines.text: Ding!

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: Floor two. The Cable Jungle.
lines.text: Floor two. The Cable Jungle.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.raw: [scared] Juno, I can't. That's a real gap. With real... falling.
lines.text: Juno, I can't. That's a real gap. With real... falling.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [warm] Dex. Look at it. Platforms. Swinging ropes. A gap. [pause] What does that look like?
lines.text: Dex. Look at it. Platforms. Swinging ropes. A gap. What does that look like?

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.raw: [slowly realizing] ...It's an obby. [excited] It's just an OBBY!
lines.text: ...It's an obby. It's just an OBBY!

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.raw: [hyped] Twelve thousand hours of practice, BABY!
lines.text: Twelve thousand hours of practice, BABY!

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: Floor two and a half. The Lost and Found. Every item anyone ever lost in a game.
lines.text: Floor two and a half. The Lost and Found. Every item anyone ever lost in a game.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.raw: [gasps, excited] My first sword! I lost it in third grade!
lines.text: My first sword! I lost it in third grade!

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.raw: [happy] Ding!
lines.text: Ding!

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [awed, whispering] Floor three. The Archive.
lines.text: Floor three. The Archive.

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.raw: [warm] Every game anyone ever made... is kept here. Every single one.
lines.text: Every game anyone ever made... is kept here. Every single one.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [touched] Even mine.
lines.text: Even mine.

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.raw: [gentle] Especially yours. Every world someone builds with love... gets a shelf.
lines.text: Especially yours. Every world someone builds with love... gets a shelf.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [quiet] I always thought my game didn't matter. Three visits. [pause] But somebody kept it anyway.
lines.text: I always thought my game didn't matter. Three visits. But somebody kept it anyway.

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.raw: [warm] A game doesn't need a million visits to matter, Juno. It just needs someone who made it.
lines.text: A game doesn't need a million visits to matter, Juno. It just needs someone who made it.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [scared] But at the end of the hall... the bubbles were turning grey.
lines.text: But at the end of the hall... the bubbles were turning grey.

lines.speaker: LAG
lines.raw: [booming, slow, glitchy] More... players... more... rushing... MORE... FOOD.
lines.text: More... players... more... rushing... MORE... FOOD.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [whispering] Every player on Earth was rushing to play one last game. And every one of them... was feeding him.
lines.text: Every player on Earth was rushing to play one last game. And every one of them... was feeding him.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.raw: [cocky] Stand back. I've beaten every boss in Roblox.
lines.text: Stand back. I've beaten every boss in Roblox.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: Dex, wait—
lines.text: Dex, wait—

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.raw: [muffled, groans] ...Real life is SO badly designed.
lines.text: ...Real life is SO badly designed.

lines.speaker: LAG
lines.raw: [laughing slowly, glitchy] Ha. [pause] Ha. [pause] Ha. [pause] Ha.
lines.text: Ha. Ha. Ha. Ha.

lines.speaker: LAG
lines.raw: [slow, booming] Tomorrow... no more... games. No more... obbies. No more... elevators.
lines.text: Tomorrow... no more... games. No more... obbies. No more... elevators.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.raw: [angry, tiny] ...Not the elevator.
lines.text: ...Not the elevator.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [determined] My turn. I'm a BUILDER!
lines.text: My turn. I'm a BUILDER!

lines.speaker: LAG
lines.raw: [slow, mocking] Wall... not... loaded.
lines.text: Wall... not... loaded.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [annoyed] Oh, come ON!
lines.text: Oh, come ON!

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.raw: [calm, robotic] Shutdown in five minutes. Thanks for playing! Smiley face.
lines.text: Shutdown in five minutes. Thanks for playing! Smiley face.

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.raw: [shocked] My mop! He ate my MOP!
lines.text: My mop! He ate my MOP!

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [thinking out loud] Grandpa... you said he eats traffic. Everybody rushing at once.
lines.text: Grandpa... you said he eats traffic. Everybody rushing at once.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [slowly, realizing] What if there was NO traffic? Not forever. Just for... ten seconds?
lines.text: What if there was NO traffic? Not forever. Just for... ten seconds?

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.raw: [realizing] If every single player logged off at the same time... he'd have nothing to eat.
lines.text: If every single player logged off at the same time... he'd have nothing to eat.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.raw: [disbelief] Juno! Nobody logs off! Not on the LAST DAY!
lines.text: Juno! Nobody logs off! Not on the LAST DAY!

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [determined] Then we ask. Everyone. At once.
lines.text: Then we ask. Everyone. At once.

lines.speaker: LAG
lines.raw: [slow, deep, glitchy] One... min... min... minute... left.
lines.text: One... min... min... minute... left.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [shouting] Pip! Press the button!
lines.text: Pip! Press the button!

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.raw: [cheerful, tiny] Ding!
lines.text: Ding!

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [nervous, then sincere] Um. Hi. I'm Juno. I'm eleven. I'm... a builder.
lines.text: Um. Hi. I'm Juno. I'm eleven. I'm... a builder.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: I know it's the last day. I know you want to play every single second. Me too.
lines.text: I know it's the last day. I know you want to play every single second. Me too.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: But there's a monster eating our servers. And he eats when we all rush.
lines.text: But there's a monster eating our servers. And he eats when we all rush.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [sincere] We can play tomorrow. And the day after. But only if we stop... right now.
lines.text: We can play tomorrow. And the day after. But only if we stop... right now.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [softly, sincere] So please... just for ten seconds... put down your phone. Log off. [pause] And look up.
lines.text: So please... just for ten seconds... put down your phone. Log off. And look up.

lines.speaker: STREAMER
lines.raw: [quiet, sincere] Chat... I'll be right back.
lines.text: Chat... I'll be right back.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [softly] And then... one by one... the world logged off.
lines.text: And then... one by one... the world logged off.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.raw: [robotic] Players online: eight hundred million...
lines.text: Players online: eight hundred million...

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.raw: [robotic] Ten million... ten thousand... ten...
lines.text: Ten million... ten thousand... ten...

lines.speaker: LAG
lines.raw: [panicking, slow] No... no... come... back... play... one... more...
lines.text: No... no... come... back... play... one... more...

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.raw: [quiet] Players online... zero.
lines.text: Players online... zero.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.raw: [whispering, amazed] ...The Touch Grass badge.
lines.text: ...The Touch Grass badge.

lines.speaker: LAG
lines.raw: [tiny, cute, high-pitched] ...hi.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.raw: [surprised, robotic] Lag... not found. [pause] Shutdown... canceled!
lines.text: Lag... not found. Shutdown... canceled!

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.raw: [cheerful] Thanks for playing! Smiley face.
lines.text: Thanks for playing! Smiley face.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [laughing, crying] We did it! We actually DID it!
lines.text: We did it! We actually DID it!

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.raw: [proud, warm] Ten seconds. That's all the world needed.
lines.text: Ten seconds. That's all the world needed.

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.raw: [running, excited] Juno! I touched grass! I TOUCHED GRASS!
lines.text: Juno! I touched grass! I TOUCHED GRASS!

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [laughing] We know, Dex. We know.
lines.text: We know, Dex. We know.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.raw: [whispering] Can I keep him?
lines.text: Can I keep him?

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [pause] ...Fine. But you're feeding him.
lines.text: ...Fine. But you're feeding him.

lines.speaker: ANCHOR
lines.raw: [cheerful] Good morning! Roblox is staying! Scientists are calling it "The Great AFK": the first time in history... the whole world went outside at the same time.
lines.text: Good morning! Roblox is staying! Scientists are calling it "The Great AFK": the first time in history... the whole world went outside at the same time.

lines.speaker: ANCHOR
lines.raw: [pause] Everyone agrees it was weird. [pause] And kind of nice.
lines.text: Everyone agrees it was weird. And kind of nice.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [crying happily] It was worth the wait!
lines.text: It was worth the wait!

lines.speaker: DEX
lines.raw: [proud] Ten minutes of real life a day. [pause] Still no respawn. But the graphics are amazing.
lines.text: Ten minutes of real life a day. Still no respawn. But the graphics are amazing.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [happy, amazed] And Bubble Island? Three visits... became three MILLION.
lines.text: And Bubble Island? Three visits... became three MILLION.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [proud] Oh, and I finally finished it. Now the bubbles pop.
lines.text: Oh, and I finally finished it. Now the bubbles pop.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: Pip rode a real elevator for the first time. [pause] He gave it two stars. Too slow.
lines.text: Pip rode a real elevator for the first time. He gave it two stars. Too slow.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.raw: [disappointed] ...Ding.
lines.text: ...Ding.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: And Mom finally finished her bath. [pause] She was a little wrinkly.
lines.text: And Mom finally finished her bath. She was a little wrinkly.

lines.speaker: GRANDPA
lines.raw: [cheerful] They gave me my old job back! Night janitor! [pause] Best job in the world.
lines.text: They gave me my old job back! Night janitor! Best job in the world.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [warm] And now, every year, on the same day... we all log off for ten seconds. [pause] Just to say hi to the real world.
lines.text: And now, every year, on the same day... we all log off for ten seconds. Just to say hi to the real world.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.raw: [proud] His name is Buffer.
lines.text: His name is Buffer.

lines.speaker: DAD
lines.raw: [annoyed, glitchy] Juno... why... is... the... Wi... Wi... Wi-Fi...
lines.text: Juno... why... is... the... Wi... Wi... Wi-Fi...

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [to camera, deadpan] ...Here we go again.
lines.text: ...Here we go again.

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: [warm, to camera] So... what would YOU do if Roblox had only twenty-four hours left? Tell me in the comments!
lines.text: So... what would YOU do if Roblox had only twenty-four hours left? Tell me in the comments!

lines.speaker: JUNO
lines.raw: And hey... maybe log off for ten seconds today. Look up. [pause] Then come right back and watch another video!
lines.text: And hey... maybe log off for ten seconds today. Look up. Then come right back and watch another video!

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.raw: [cheerful] Ding!
lines.text: Ding!
